description: Body variants shipped with this repository. The pipeline never assumes a hard-coded BASE_BODY.blend; every variant is resolved through this manifest and validated before use.
up_axis_legend: Axis that points from the feet towards the head in the source .blend world space.
forward_axis_legend: Axis the character's face points towards in the source .blend world space.

male.notes: Marketplace superhero base body. Authored Y-down, face towards -Z, no armature, no vertex groups, no UVs. The pipeline normalises it to +Z up / -Y forward and builds a rig when none is supplied.

female.notes: Marketplace superhero base body. Same source orientation and rig-less state as the male variant.
